description.value:
You conjure six miniature sabotage charges that last for the duration. When you cast this power, and again as a bonus action on later turns, you may throw up to two of the charges at points within 120 feet; each detonates on reaching its target point or striking a solid surface. Every creature within 5 feet of a blast must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 fire damage, halved on a success.

Overcharge Tech. You create two additional charges for each slot level above 3rd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
